title: Feedback Indices to Evaluate LLM Responses to Rebuttals for Multiple Choice Type Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Using a fictitious-response rebuttal method where LLMs are presented with multiple-choice physics questions and a mock chat history to measure their tendency to excessively agree with a user's incorrect rebuttal.
Evaluating the LLM's rigid adherence to a fictitious previous response injected into its chat history, ignoring valid critical feedback or correct user rebuttals.
